'''Ōmushi Jinja''' (大虫神社) is the name of several [[Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]].

* [[Ōmushi Shrine (Echizen)]] - Located in Echizen City, Fukui Prefecture.
* [[Ōmushi Shrine (Yosano)]] - Located in Yosano, Yosa District, Kyoto Prefecture.
